All five Gate 1 revisions have been applied to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152507-feature-extend-arrowhead-size/requirements.md`:

1. **Presets and range (`FR-1`, `FR-3`, `FR-4`, `FR-10`, `FR-16`):** Defined presets Small = `0.5`, Medium = `1` (default, omitted from elements), and Large = `1.5` (capped at 1.5x), with the supported range defined as finite numbers in `[0.5, 1.5]` inclusive. `FR-3` retains in-range values other than `1` and strips `1`, out-of-range values, and invalid values; `FR-4` falls back to `1` when `currentItemArrowheadSize` is missing or outside `[0.5, 1.5]`; `FR-16` examples updated accordingly (`0.75` kept, `0.4` and `1.6` stripped).
2. **Bounds rationale (`Out of scope #3`):** Stated that size does not change short-segment fitting, so a head's extent along the shaft stays on the shaft and only its sideways extent can exceed the shaft's bounding box (already true at today's sizes).
3. **Head geometry & angle criteria (`FR-6`, `FR-15`, `AC-3`):** Specified testing `getArrowheadPoints` head geometry (not element bounding box), added the measurable sideways half-width scaling criterion (`s * halfWidth(1)` at `0.5` and `1.5` on a long straight segment with unchanged head angle), added the explicit regression test that an `"arrow"` head at Small (`0.5`) stays at 20°, and specified in `FR-6` that `getArrowheadAngle` compares drawn size against the scaled full size (`getArrowheadSize(arrowhead, scale)`).
4. **Known export padding limit (`Out of scope #8`):** Documented that exported images frame the shafts plus the 10px export padding, so wide heads can be cropped at the image edge (bar 15px and cardinality-one 20px today; arrow 12.8px, bar 22.5px, and cardinality-one 30px at 1.5x), and that this run does not change export padding.
5. **Older-client forward compatibility (`Out of scope #6`):** Clarified that `restoreElementWithProperties` spreads `...element`, so older clients keep `arrowheadSize` through restore and edits and render today's size.
